ns2:course.label: Geochemistry
ns2:course.description: Fundamental chemical and physical concepts applied to geological processes; topics include: origin, distribution, and geochemical behavior of elements; chemical evolution of the Earth; geochemistry of natural waters and sedimentary rocks; isotope geochemistry, crystal chemistry, trace element geochemistry and organic geochemistry. Prerequisite: GEOL 101 or GEOL 107; CHEM 104 and CHEM 105; MATH 220; or consent of instructor.
